text: ボールを　かいたして　おこう

structure.jp: かいたして　おこう
structure.en: I'll buy some more ahead of time

patterns.name: 〜ておく
patterns.span: かいたして　おこう
patterns.explanation: おく after a て-form verb says you do the thing now so you are ready for later. かいたして　おこう = 'I'll buy more now, to be ready'.

patterns.name: 〜よう
patterns.explanation: The おう ending says 'I'll do it' or 'let's do it', a decision made on the spot. おこう = 'I'll go ahead and do it'.
